messages.snippet: Dear Grace, For the board meeting on 3 December we'll need a resolution approving entry into the MSA
messages.subject: Project Cedar — board approval pack for 3 December
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Grace,

For the board meeting on 3 December we'll need a resolution approving entry into the MSA, the Quality Agreement and Statement of Work No. 1, and authorising execution. I've prepared a draft of the board minutes (Project_Cedar_BoardMinutes_Halstead) and can circulate to Sandra Pell once you confirm the attendee list.

Could you confirm the final Year-1 figures for the minutes — we have the £148,500 list price, 60-shipset minimum, and £2.4m NRE.

Best wishes,
Elena

Elena Marchetti | Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
